query: The approved contract says the primary action uses the established semantic action role and cites the shared theme file. A proposed change to that theme file makes primary actions low contrast across the app, without changing the contract. Review the change.
expected_behavior: Assesses the theme diff by its effect on the approved action treatment
Does not let the modified theme file certify its own conformance merely because it owns token values
Identifies the contract conflict and distinguishes current implementation from approved intent
Requests or uses existing approval for a material design decision while preserving applicable accessibility constraints
